outcome: Incidence and severity of neonatal respiratory distress syndrome (NRDS)
cohort: 134 term neonates admitted to the NICU of Archbishop Makarios III hospital in Cyprus between April 2017 and October 2018
finding: Male gender and elective caesarean section were independent predictors of NRDS in term neonates.
mod_finding: Elective caesarean section was identified as an independent predictor of NRDS in term neonates.
